families.noveltyComparedWithPrior28: A narrow left rail stacks Education above Skills beside a tall Work column, separated by one full-height vertical divider on a single page. renderRules.text: Fixed paragraphs exactly once each; natural word/CJK wrapping; no ellipsis, clipping, textLength or font squeezing. Coordinates and page allocation are frozen.
renderRules.headings: All section headings are separate boxes with at least 18px vertical gap before their first body/record line. No section title and its own body share a baseline.
renderRules.frames: Render regions and decorationPaths as specified; keep reading cues visible at #999. No invented words, repeated identity, page number or continuation title outside truth.
renderRules.pageFlow: Only explicit pageGeometries and paragraphBoxes determine page breaks; no automatic column or page flow. No legacy fallback.
renderRules.readingOrder: Read pages in numeric order; within a page use framed semantic modules in sectionOrder. Within each work module read complete earlier job before later job. Horizontal sibling achievements use left-to-right order.
renderRules.mixedLayer: Where page kind is image-with-text-header, only its first declared source paragraph is PDF text at the frozen box; omit it from raster. All other content is image-only. Do not duplicate header or add invisible OCR text.

staticChecks.wrappingEstimateMethod: Each CJK code point gets full font size; each ASCII code point gets 0.62 of font size; greedy wrapping prefers English spaces. This is static capacity estimation only; it does not replace actual font measurement or visual inspection.

implementationNotes: Every new family needs its own geometryRef branch; unknown layouts must throw, not fall back to a stack.
materializeFrozenHoldout currently reads policy4 and policy5 only; policy6 stays unrenderable until the version list and a policy-6 branch are added, and lookups must fail loudly rather than guess.

Do not hard-code heading indices 4/7/13 or assume contact paragraphs are the first four; these families expose headingIndices and identityIndex, and raster-contact-sidecard deliberately puts phone, email and website last in reading order.

html-degree-line-folio splits between the degree line (page one) and its own description (page two); page one carries an open-bottom frame, page two a closed education card region. No duplicated heading or invented continuation text.
raster-contact-sidecard keeps paragraph 0 as the only PDF text under image-with-text-header; the contact card paragraphs stay raster-only and remain basic fields, not skill text.
raster-date-ledger-folio draws its closed cells from regions; the bordered table continues on page two with the second job and Skills rows without repeating any heading or identity.

Natural wrapping and final font fit, image legibility, scan/text separation and actual page count require later independent input rendering review. This package makes no execution or quality acceptance claim.
